propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE env var must point to a TOML file whose keys layer (merge) over discovered config rather than replacing it, enabling per-environment LLM config overrides without repo edits
Precedence order must be: CLI `-c` flag > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env vars > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered config file > default
Deep recursive merge over nested tables (leaf key wins) and wholesale array replacement (not append) must be implemented in the LLM resolver without modifying read_reserved_section
REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must be read via literal string os.environ.get call so static AST scanner in gen_env_registry.py can document it and CI drift gate can verify
Missing config file pointed to by REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must raise a typed rebar config error naming the variable rather than silently falling back
Empty or minimal pointed config must enable hermetic tests where model resolution is independent of upstream rebar.toml (similar to AWS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null pattern)
